footer.tagline: Business-to-business procurement for construction materials in Sri Lanka.

home.headline: Build the list. Find the supply. Compare what actually matters.
home.lede: A business-to-business desk for construction materials. List what the project needs, receive quotes you can put side by side, and place orders against a written record instead of a phone call.

trio.label: Ways to start
trio.knowBody: Name it, spec it, and see who lists it — side by side.
trio.browseBody: Walk the departments and compare materials at leisure.
trio.suppliersBody: Meet the directory first, then ask for quotes.

departments.title: Shop by department
departments.lede: Twelve departments, one live catalogue. Pick a trade and start comparing.

pulse.note: Live catalogue figures — read from the platform on every visit, never printed.

strip.title: Fresh on the shelves
strip.lede: The newest listings with their real specifications. Drag through them, or open any card for the full sheet.

suppliers.title: Verified first, always
suppliers.lede: The directory leads with verified suppliers. Open a row for the full dossier.

field.title: Where the catalogue reaches
field.lede: No case studies yet — so here is what the directory itself says: districts served, verified share, department depth.

final.title: Put the next purchase on the record.
final.lede: List what the site needs once, and let suppliers answer against the same lines.

workflow.title: Four steps, one record.
workflow.lede: Each stage leaves something both sides can point back to.
workflow.step1Body: Add products with quantities and units, or upload a bill of quantities. Nothing leaves your account until you submit it.
workflow.step2Body: Matched suppliers quote price, lead time, validity and terms against the same line items.
workflow.step3Body: Quotes line up item by item, so the differences that decide the purchase are visible rather than buried.
workflow.step4Body: Accept a quote and the order, its deliveries and its payments stay in one place.

errors.unexpected: We could not complete this. Quote reference {reference} when you contact support.
errors.unexpectedNoReference: We could not complete this action just now. Try again in a moment — if it keeps happening, note the time and let us know.
errors.network: We could not reach Stockpile.lk. Check your connection and try again.
errors.timeout: The request took too long. Try again — the action may still be running.
errors.validation: Check the highlighted fields and try again.
errors.INVALID_CREDENTIALS: That email and password combination is not correct. Check them and try again.
errors.ACCOUNT_LOCKED: Too many failed attempts. This account is temporarily locked — try again in a few minutes.
errors.EMAIL_NOT_VERIFIED: Confirm your email address before continuing. We can send the link again.
errors.SESSION_EXPIRED: Your session has expired. Sign in again to continue.
errors.ANTIFORGERY_FAILED: We could not verify this request. Reload the page and try again.
errors.REFRESH_REUSED: That sign-in was already used elsewhere, so we ended both sessions for safety. Sign in again.
errors.INVALID_VERIFICATION_TOKEN: That confirmation link is no longer valid.
errors.INVALID_RESET_TOKEN: That reset link is no longer valid. Request a new one.
errors.INSUFFICIENT_CAPABILITY: Your account does not include this action. Ask an administrator to grant it.
errors.NOT_ORGANIZATION_MEMBER: You are not a member of this organization.
errors.RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND: We could not find that. It may have been removed, or you may not have access to it.
errors.CROSS_TENANT_DENIED: That record belongs to another organization.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: You have made a lot of requests. Wait {seconds} seconds and try again.
errors.VALIDATION_FAILED: Some details are not valid yet. Fix the highlighted fields.
errors.CONCURRENCY_CONFLICT: Someone else changed this while you were editing. Reload to get the latest version.
errors.IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REQUIRED: This action needs a retry key. Reload the page and try again.
errors.IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE: This retry key was already used with different details. Start the action again.
errors.STATE_TRANSITION_INVALID: This action is not available from the current status.
